Hair Color Pattern - Underlayer Color.description:
🌈 Hair Color Pattern: Hair Color Pattern - Underlayer Color
A contrasting color visible underneath the top layer of hair — hidden when hair is down, revealed by movement or updos.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Hair Color Pattern - Underlayer Color.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply the selected secondary hair color using a underlayer color pattern. If no secondary hair color is selected, keep the pattern subtle or skip it rather than inventing an unrelated color.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
